signature: highlightIsolate(key: string, value: unknown, color?: string): number
returns: 高亮的对象数量 (0 表示没找到)
code: const list = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('renderType', 'CEILING'); if (list.length === 0) throw new Error('未找到 CEILING'); const targets = new Set(list); ssp.getContext().scene.traverse((obj) => { if (obj.isMesh) ssp.objectsTool.setVisible(obj, targets.has(obj)); }); list.forEach((obj) => ssp.objectsTool.setHighlight(obj, '#ff0000', true)); await ssp.cameraController.flyToObject(list[0]); console.log('isolated and highlighted', list.length, 'CEILING');
guard: list 为空时应停止执行，避免把整个场景隐藏
pulse=true 会启动 setInterval(500ms) 闪烁, 调 clearAllHighlights 或 unHighlight 停止
对象数组上千时高亮会影响渲染性能 (每帧重算 emissive)
flyToObject 不支持 viewpoint 选项, 只支持 enableTransition / done
执行后可用 resetVisibility + clearAllHighlights 恢复场景
GLB userData 字段取决于实际 GLB metadata, 常见: renderType / spaceType / floorName / building / sid / level
